title: Super Crunch Oven Cooked Honey Dipped Wings
description: This recipe for super crunch oven-cooked honey-dipped wings includes breaded, baked chicken wings tossed with a spicy honey sauce for this crunchy appetizer.
ingredients: 20 chicken wings, separated at joints, tips discarded
salt and black pepper to taste

steps.text: Whisk buttermilk, hot pepper sauce, 1 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon black pepper, onion powder, and garlic powder together in a bowl; pour into a resealable plastic bag. Add chicken wings, coat with marinade, squeeze out excess air, and seal the bag. Marinate in the refrigerator 12 to 24 hours.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Coat 2 baking sheets with cooking spray.
Combine crushed cornflakes, flour, and cornmeal in a bowl; season with salt and black pepper. Remove chicken wings from marinade and shake off excess. Discard remaining marinade.
Press wings into cornflake mixture to coat. Place onto the prepared baking sheets. Coat tops of wings with cooking spray.
Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink and meat easily pulls from the bone, 30 to 40 minutes.
While wings are cooking, combine honey and pepper flakes in a small saucepan over medium heat until honey thins; keep warm until wings are ready.
Place wings in a large mixing bowl; drizzle with honey sauce. Toss until evenly coated.

video.description:
Who wouldn’t love crispy cornflake breading drizzled with spicy honey and baked 
in the oven? A quick buttermilk marinade with hot pepper sauce, garlic and onion 
powders, then chicken wings rolled in cornflakes - these crunchy wings will please 
everyone who's at the table!
